First release · in development

Vilna Blavet

The first release of Vilna is called Blavet. In Valencian the word means both the cornflower and the kingfisher, a small blue bird with an orange breast.

Why Blavet

Vilna releases are named after flowers. The cornflower and the kingfisher share the colours of Vilna: blue, orange and gold. Every release has its own mark, while the Vilna logo and the Gloxi owl stay the same.

How it looks

The light style is the default, with the Sun wallpaper; the dark style is one switch away. The Blavet wallpaper turns the wing of the kingfisher into a Petrykivka ornament.

What is inside

Gloxi

The assistant that runs a language model on your own computer and acts only with your permission.

Herkos

The guard between Gloxi and your system: it shows what will change, asks you and keeps a log.

Updates

Based on openSUSE Aeon: the system updates itself in the background, and every update can be rolled back.

When

Blavet is in development. The alpha is planned by March 2028. You can follow the work in the open code.
